risks: Post-publication data drift: current live download counts differ from the published paper counts, though disease count (566) matches exactly, confirming file identity is correct.

No machine-readable disease ontology codes in the bulk files despite the paper's DO/MeSH mapping claim — downstream consumers will need free-text disease name matching if ontology normalization is required later.
Confidence score described in the paper is not exposed in any bulk download file.
